purpose: Complete disk-piece normality module with actual joint complexity after a supplied finite saddle position, before repeated-bubble moves.
interface: Two supplied smooth complementary balls, protected crossing balls disjoint from both open ball interiors, nonsplit link on their boundary/complement, supplied two-point sphere in finite saddle position. No initial saddle-position existence claimed.
proof_plan: Minimize (#protected saddles,total cut circles). Ball compression of a nondisk piece gives a disk in one open ball; disk replacement removes a puncture-free sphere disk containing at least one cut circle and whole saddle disks, adds neither. Contradiction to joint minimum.
